facts.fact: The LCA/ITU sector review (data collected August 2016) states that Lesotho's operators draw international bandwidth from the WACS, EASSy and SEACOM cables, which Lesotho, being landlocked, reaches via South Africa: Vodacom Lesotho via its group's ownership of WACS and EASSy, Econet Telecom Lesotho via SEACOM and EASSy capacity through Liquid Telecom's terrestrial fibre.

systems.owner: Vodacom group (part-owner); capacity also used by Econet Telecom Lesotho

systems.tiers: national backbone for Vodacom and Econet

note: Wholesale internet bandwidth is described as a duopoly with a price, but the capture is truncated before any statement on capacity sold at a landing station; no access fact.
